The building in front of me is the largest structure I've seen since coming to the countryside.
I can't help but admire it. And besides the house itself, there's a spacious backyard.
I take another look at the surroundings, then double check the address.
The pleasant breeze, the sound of flowing water, the chirping of birds and insects—
Boy would this be a nice place to retire.
After adjusting my clothes and making sure I look presentable, I press the doorbell.
“Yeah, yeah, I know. you're the housekeeper, right?”
I had assumed I'd be taking care of elderly people.
But three very beautiful women stand before me.
Each one gives off a different vibe... and I keep getting whiffs of pleasant fragrances.
There's only two similarities: They're all dressed as nuns, and...
Holy shit their bodies are hot!
Suddenly, I start feeling a bit uneasy.
Are these beautiful women the c-customer?
This isn't what I expected... not at all!
“Excuse me, can I clarify something first?”
“No wonder he's been looking so freaked out.”
“You sure it isn't your overbearing attitude?”
“Makes sense that seeing nuns might be a bit confusing.”
“But the three of us live here. We're just heading to the church.”
“They call it a church, but we basically just chat with the village elders and listen to their troubles. We're not real nuns.”
“Haha... Doesn't matter. You're here to help with the housekeeping.”
“Like cleaning, laundry, shopping, and of course, the most important part, food!”
“In return, you get good pay, your own room, and you can use anything in the house.”
“And don't be too formal, rest when you want, and treat us like family!”
“I get it... this is the countryside. If there's anything you're not satisfied with, we can talk about it.”
“No, no, the environment here is great, and I'm very satisfied with the pay.”
All three of them tilt their heads, seemingly unable to understand my concern.
“I... I... I... I'm a man!!! Through and through!”
I pull out my ID and show them my gender, as if my presence isn't enough.
“After all, Miss Shizuko recommended you. That alone is enough.”
“Oooooo? Maybe... you're having some naughty thoughts?”
“Were you expecting some hot, spicy moments with three sexy ladies?”
“Wahaha! Soooo cute! Did you see how his expression changed?!”
“We really don't mind, and you don't quite match the description Miss Shizuko gave.”
“True. You seem more normal than we imagined.”
“Haha... Yeah, kinda like a little brother.”
“We thought you'd be some hairy, muscular guy.”
“The image of him cooking in an apron is hilarious.”
“If someone like that came, we'd make him sleep in the yard.”
“We have a tent ready, but he'd have to set it up himself.”
“Hehe. They're just joking. We've prepared a room for you.”
The memory of being slapped keeps replaying in my mind.
Shizuko said they knew about my situation.
But... I need to calm down. After all, this is my last chance...
“Let's get your luggage to your room first?”
“You can use it however you like.”
“You still seem a bit shaken? Still worried?”
“Well... I thought I'd be helping older folks, so it's not what I expected.”
“Well... you being like this makes me uncomfortable.”
“Is it because you're not good with women?”
“Does it have something to do with you?”
Ayano keeps sizing me up, especially my lower half.
“Hmm... Shizuko might have exaggerated a bit.”
“Anyway, this is my room. The other two rooms belong to Kasumi and Shizuku.”
“The bathroom and toilet are around the corner.”
“Feel free to take a look around. Your main job is just to keep the place clean and cook delicious food.”
“Alright, anything else you want to know?”
“The house is huge, they're dressed as nuns, and they're letting a stranger roam their house!”
“Well, better get familiar with the place.”
